intro: Election Day Tuesday, and KC kept the feed lively: teasing that something big is "very close," checking in on @gork (twice!), and keeping the Stocktwits crowd guessing. The man stays booked and busy. 🗳️📈

items.caption: Remember last week's mysterious "SOON . . . ." post? KC quote-posted it with an update: we're getting very close now. The suspense is unreal. 👀
Sunday he asked "Hey @gork are you still there?" Today he answered himself with a narrator voiceover. Self-quoting comedy at its finest. 🎬
Someone posted the "I'll only trust my brain from now on" meme, and KC fired back with a GIF reply. Sometimes a GIF says it all. 🧠
When @Konraddin announced he voted "for all the good things and against the bad ones," KC hit him with the ultimate one-word review. 🤓
Over on Stocktwits, KC backed up @HeyYouWhoMe with a classic three-word cosign. 📣
And by the afternoon he was calling in the fact-checker. @gork appearances today: two platforms and counting. 🔍
